snippet.title: Don't Fall (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/app/dont-fall/id1042402213

Android : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.dontfall

Slide the yellow cubes with your finger in order to fill all the holes in the path. The ball must not fall down ! Collect as many gems as you can to unlock new characters.
